extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.metric: Blinkit (quick commerce) order value growth, medium term
items.quote: We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR and that would obviously mean some reasonable store expansion, but we're not planning to give out any specific number guidance on that.
items.actual: 79% year on year in Q2 FY27
items.why: Blinkit's order value grew 79% in Q2, a figure raised on the October call that management did not dispute, and it said growth would pick up further from December.
items.actual_quote: And then when you're guiding for growth to pick up in Blinkit from 79%, are you specifically referring to the December quarter, or is that a more generic comment for the next 12 months?

note: Eternal publishes its numbers in a shareholder letter; the call transcripts are questions and answers only, so few promises can be checked.
